prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How would you like to adopt your desktop pet?", "Select a ready-to-play companion or create a personalized pet from your own photos.", "Choose Adoption Style"]
1: ["Your pet's desktop activity profile has been configured."]
2: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Use keyboard shortcuts or right-click the system tray icon anytime to manage your pet.", "Start Interacting"]
3: ["Save Your Companion Profile", "Sign in now to keep your companion synced across devices and protect your progress.", "Save & Complete"]
4: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account to instantly restore your existing pet and progress."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home...", "We are calibrating animations and desktop interactions. Your pet will spawn shortly.", "Desktop Habitat Status"]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best accuracy, upload well-lit photos showing your pet's face clearly against a simple background.", "Tip: Clear lighting yields best 3D pet accuracy"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Sign your name below to finalize your companion adoption bond.", "OFFICIALLY ADOPTED"]
8: ["Quick Controls: Right-click the system tray icon to hide, mute, or summon your pet at any time."]
9: ["Meet Your Lightweight Desktop Companion", "Enjoy a charming, low-resource pet that keeps you company while you work, study, or relax without interrupting your workflow.", "Choose Your Companion"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (the user's name).
